purpose.summary: This is a monthly billing/receipt summary report program (月次台帳・月計表) for the ORCA Japanese Medical Association standard receipt software system. It processes inpatient/outpatient medical billing records, computes totals (insurance amounts, self-pay amounts, subsidies, reductions, deposits), and produces a monthly ledger printout. It handles multiple insurance combinations, doctor codes, ward categories, and various fee adjustments.

verdict.notes: The file is decoded as latin-1 but the Japanese comments are multi-byte encoded (likely EUC-JP), causing mojibake in the displayed text. The program is clearly part of the open-source ORCA medical receipt system developed by the Japan Medical Association. The large size (4984 lines, ~217KB), extensive revision history, copyright header, and production-quality structure all indicate a mature production program. No truncation issues affect the classification.
